title: describe_node_catalog specification
description: specification payload for action=describe_node_catalog (Blueprint domain, WS-06). Read-only discovery of node types placeable in target.graph_id, with the exact pin names submit_graph edges must use. Backed by Epic FBlueprintActionDatabase, the same source as the editor palette.

graph_id.description: Graph within the target Blueprint whose schema decides what is placeable. When omitted, the primary event graph is used. target.graph_id takes precedence.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against menu name, category and keywords. Omit to enumerate everything up to max_results.

node_classes.description: Keep only these UEdGraphNode short class names, e.g. K2Node_CallFunction. Empty or omitted means any class.

categories.description: Keep only entries whose palette category starts with one of these, e.g. "Utilities|String". Empty or omitted means any category.

include_pins.description: Read pin signatures off each returned node's template. Set false for a cheaper name-only sweep when narrowing a broad search.

max_results.description: Cap on returned entries. Template nodes are instantiated only for entries within the cap; diagnostics.node_catalog.total_matched reports how many passed the filters.
